title: 14.3% Of Americans Have Money Waiting In State Vaults
hook: 14.3% of Americans have money waiting in state vaults.
closing: A free state search could return money you forgot was yours.
question: Have you checked your state?

segments.say: California holds 15 billion dollars in unclaimed money. The largest state vault is filled with other people's forgotten cash.
States returned only about one dollar in every sixteen they hold. Most unclaimed money still waits for its owners.
About one in seven Americans has money waiting. A free state search can tell you whether some is yours.
